summary: Comprehensive diagnostic audit and targeted fix plan for Hindi Devanagari detection (preserving Unicode matras \p{M}, fixing [अ-द] option range for ब/स and क-घ, supporting Devanagari numerals ०-९ and PDF CMap/UTF-16 decoding), file encoding & answer format parsing, smart Subject/Topic/Subtopic auto-categorisation for PDF/CSV/JSON, and post-upload Preview Workbench improvements without modifying any other part of the application.
